layers.text: Change only the colours: the red royal robe becomes near-black charcoal with a thin bright violet trim along its collar; the crown becomes dull tarnished bronze; the pale blue flame and his eye sockets become bright glowing violet, nothing blue is left. Keep the pale ivory skull, the bone hand, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
